layout: Two separate 16x16 PNGs per state: hanging_<state> is rind/casing; hanging_<state>_cut is flesh. Bone is a separate shared 16x16 PNG.
resampling: Each panel is exported independently from the original generated full-resolution source with nearest-neighbor sampling to 16x16. No recoloring or new image generation.

entries.prompt: Create ONE production opaque Minecraft pixel-art TEXTURE ATLAS, square canvas, exactly a logical 16x16 grid (large flat square pixel clusters if enlarged). Two rectangular panels stacked vertically with a precise horizontal seam at the midpoint: TOP HALF rows 0-7 is outer rind/casing; BOTTOM HALF rows 8-15 is exposed meat cross-section. Both panels fill their entire rectangular area edge to edge. This is a UV material map, NOT an object illustration or icon. Do not draw silhouettes, circles, rounded borders, perspective, lighting gradients, shadows, text, labels, margins, separators, checkers or rope. Each panel has uniformly lit sparse Minecraft-style color clusters, restrained 6-9 muted colors, matching vanilla food and Farmer's Delight and Italian's Delight cheeses. Completely opaque alpha everywhere, including all corners. The two panels meet directly with no gap or border. TOP HALF material: fresh light rosy pink pork skin with ivory salt flecks. BOTTOM HALF material: rosy pink lean pork and a thick ivory fat band along the left edge. Keep meat and fat features coarse and readable in an actual 16x8 panel. No twine: twine is separate geometry.
